framework.name: Demonstration MSP framework
framework.source: demonstration set written for the hackathon

controls.title: Information security policy reviewed annually
controls.requirement: The information security policy is reviewed, updated where needed and approved at least once a year.

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities defined and reviewed
controls.requirement: Roles and responsibilities for service delivery and security are documented, assigned and reviewed at least once a year.

controls.title: Management review of the service management system
controls.requirement: Management reviews service performance, risks and improvements at least every quarter and records its decisions.

controls.title: Internal audit programme executed
controls.requirement: An internal audit programme covers the framework scope every year and records findings and their owners.

controls.title: Supplier and subcontractor register maintained
controls.requirement: Suppliers and subcontractors are listed, assessed for risk and their contract is reviewed twice a year.

controls.title: Incident register maintained and reviewed
controls.requirement: Every incident is recorded in a register that is reviewed monthly, with its severity and its closure date.

controls.title: Major incidents have a post-incident review
controls.requirement: Every major incident is reviewed after resolution: root cause, corrective actions and a named signatory.

controls.title: Incident response times measured against targets
controls.requirement: Response times are measured monthly against the committed targets and breaches are counted.

controls.title: Security incidents notified to the customer
controls.requirement: Security incidents affecting a customer are notified through the agreed channel within the agreed delay.

controls.title: Recurring incidents analysed as problems
controls.requirement: Recurring incidents are grouped into problem records with a root cause and a permanent fix.

controls.title: Changes approved before implementation
controls.requirement: Every production change is approved by a named approver before it is implemented.

controls.title: Emergency changes reviewed afterwards
controls.requirement: Emergency changes are justified when raised and reviewed by a second person after implementation.

controls.title: Change success measured
controls.requirement: The share of successful changes and the number of rollbacks are measured every quarter.

controls.title: Configuration baseline of managed environments
controls.requirement: A configuration baseline of the managed environments is approved and refreshed twice a year.

controls.title: Segregation of duties on production access
controls.requirement: Requesting, approving and granting production access are performed by different roles.

controls.title: Backup restoration tested
controls.requirement: Backups of the managed environments are tested by a real restore at a defined interval.

controls.title: Business continuity plan reviewed
controls.requirement: The business continuity plan is reviewed and approved once a year and covers every managed service.

controls.title: Recovery objectives defined per service
controls.requirement: Every managed service has an approved recovery time objective and recovery point objective.

controls.title: Backup jobs complete and are monitored
controls.requirement: Backup jobs are monitored monthly and failed jobs are counted and followed up.

controls.title: Continuity exercise run with a customer scenario
controls.requirement: A continuity exercise based on a customer scenario is run once a year and its lessons are recorded.

controls.title: Privileged access reviewed quarterly
controls.requirement: Privileged accounts are reviewed every quarter and unnecessary access is removed.

controls.title: Security awareness training completed
controls.requirement: Every employee completes security awareness training once a year and completion is tracked.

controls.title: Vulnerability scans run and findings tracked
controls.requirement: Managed systems are scanned monthly and findings carry severity and remediation deadlines.

controls.title: Data encrypted at rest and in transit
controls.requirement: Data at rest and in transit is encrypted with managed keys, and the control is described and approved.

controls.title: Personnel screened before privileged access
controls.requirement: Personnel granted privileged access are screened before the access is granted.

controls.title: Customer satisfaction measured
controls.requirement: Customer satisfaction is measured twice a year and the results lead to recorded actions.

controls.title: Service reviews held with each customer
controls.requirement: Each customer has a service review every quarter with minutes and agreed actions.

controls.title: Service level reports delivered
controls.requirement: A service level report is delivered to each customer every month with the measured levels.

controls.title: Customer complaints handled within the agreed delay
controls.requirement: Customer complaints are recorded and resolved within the agreed delay by a named owner.

controls.title: Customer data handling agreement on file
controls.requirement: Every customer has a signed data handling agreement that is reviewed once a year.
